sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id,SUM(re.points) points FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year,re.driver_id,re.constructor_id HAVING SUM(re.points)>0), low AS (SELECT * FROM totals t WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(points) FROM totals x WHERE x.year=t.year)), ct AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) n FROM low GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,n FROM ct JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY n DESC,c.name LIMIT 8
